test_title: SSC CPO 2022 Tier-II Official Paper (Held On: 02 May, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
**Select the option that expresses the given sentence in passive voice.**

I have not discouraged him from doing anything.

options.text: He had not been discouraged from doing anything by me.
He is not discouraging from doing anything by me
He has not been discouraged from doing anything by me.
He has not discouraged from doing anything by me.

solution:
The correct answer is: "**He has not been discouraged from doing anything by me.**"
